correctness.rationale: Contracting all positively queried path runs turns negative constraints into a max-degree-two forbidden adjacency graph on m=t+u blocks. Dirac covers m>=6; explicit cycles handle m=3,4,5. The two-component boundary is decided by exact 3- and 4-block orientation constraints, including failure for order-two/three path components. EGF and partition enumeration give all polynomial coefficients. Exhaustive edge-trace enumeration matches the theorem for every compatible support through seven vertices and representative boundary types up to nine; this is supporting finite verification, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Classifies every realizable fixed-edge trace support of the canonical Hamiltonian-cycle concept class, including exact two-component boundary exclusions and an all-order enumeration polynomial. Unlike a maximum dimension alone, the polynomial and support criterion describe the entire shattering complex and distinguish spanning-only cycles from unrestricted graph cycles.
